battle.name: 法蘭克內戰
battle.theater: 紐斯特里亞盆地與亞眠戰場
battle.brief: 七一五年墨洛溫內戰：丕平二世死後，阿達爾特魯德攝政，幼王提奧德里克四世與奧斯特拉西亞宮相查理·馬泰爾爭權；紐斯特里亞貴族拉加納爾德起兵，勾連薩克森與弗里西人，戰火延至亞眠。卡面的羅馬弩砲是扭力式攻城機具，715年已失傳七百年，編年史未記攻城弩砲；定局靠營壘封鎖、河川阻斷與亞眠之戰。

kit.name: 羅馬弩砲
kit.history: 扭力弩砲，一發一具箭。羅馬用它拆掉希臘的城牆，也拆掉了希臘的城邦體系。

countries: 這場內戰發生在墨洛溫王朝的法蘭克王國之內，交戰雙方都自稱法蘭克人。一方是紐斯特里亞的王室：丕平二世死於七一四年八月，其寡妻阿達爾特魯德以攝政身分執掌王廷，扶持幼子提奧德里克四世，並依靠紐斯特里亞的世家大族維持統治；帶頭反對的是貴族拉加納爾德，他糾集同族與武裝，號召紐斯特里亞的莊園主與地方步兵。其後拉加納爾德又把薩克森人與弗里西人拉進叛亂，把王國東面與北面的反抗接成一片。另一方是奧斯特拉西亞的宮相查理·馬泰爾，他靠萊茵河下游的奧斯特拉西亞貴族與自己主持的宮相衙署控制軍隊與行政，那衙署掌軍隊徵發、法官任命、司法與莊園賦稅，並能支配主教、修道院與關稅收入。整個王國此時分紐斯特里亞、奧斯特拉西亞與勃艮第三個宮相區，三區貴族在王位繼承與宮相任免上爭不休，因此這場衝突在編年史裡被記成紐斯特里亞人不肯服從奧斯特拉西亞的宮相，而不是外族入侵。法蘭克部隊以步兵為主，騎兵編制仍小而精；薩克森與弗里西的援軍幾乎全是步卒，沒有成建制的騎兵，三支力量的部署方式與作戰節奏因此完全不同。
countriesEn: This civil war was fought inside the Frankish kingdom of the Merovingian dynasty, and both sides called themselves Franks. On one side stood the court of Neustria: after Pepin of Herstal died in August 714, the queen Adaltrude took the regency for her young son Theuderic IV and governed with the backing of the great aristocratic houses of Neustria; the leader of the opposition was the noble Raganaldus, who mustered his kinsmen and armed followers and called upon the landed lords and local levies of Neustria. He then drew the Saxons and the Frisians into the rising, so that the revolt in the east and the revolt in the north became a single fire. On the other side stood Charles Martel, mayor of the palace of Austrasia, who held his power on the Rhineland nobles of Austrasia and on the palace administration he presided over, an office that controlled the muster of the army, the appointment of judges, the dispensing of justice and the rents of the royal estates, and that could dispose of the wealth of the bishops, the monasteries and the customs. At this moment the kingdom was divided into the three mayoralities of Neustria, Austrasia and Burgundy, and the aristocracy of each competed over the succession to the throne and over appointments to the office of mayor; the chroniclers accordingly recorded the conflict as the Neustrians refusing to obey a mayor of the palace who was not of their own choosing, and not as an invasion by a foreign people. Frankish armies were infantry-led, with cavalry still small and precious; the Saxon and Frisian auxiliaries were almost entirely foot, without formed bodies of horsemen, so that the deployment and the tempo of the three forces differed sharply from one another.
people: 留下姓名的關鍵人物有五位。第一位是丕平二世，即老丕平，約六三四至七一四年，紐斯特里亞宮相、墨洛溫王朝最後一位實權統治者；他在七一四年八月十六日死於赫斯塔爾，留下未成年的兒子與一位寡妻，這場內戰的整條因果鏈就從這具遺體開始。第二位是阿達爾特魯德，丕平二世的寡妻，攝政期間站在紐斯特里亞一邊，與奧斯特拉西亞的宮相衙署勢不兩立。第三位是提奧德里克四世，約七一〇至七一五年，幼年即位，編年史記他在七一五年死去，年僅數歲，後世還留下他被毒殺的說法，但無從核實；他一死，查理·馬泰爾得以在奧斯特拉西亞獨任宮相，成為王國唯一的主事者。第四位是查理·馬泰爾，約六八八至七四一年，卡洛林王朝的奠基者；他在七一五年接掌奧斯特拉西亞，七三二年起以王號行事，七四一年死後由其子丕平三世於七五一年廢墨洛溫而自行加冕。第五位是拉加納爾德，亦作拉杜爾福，紐斯特里亞的叛首，編年史把他寫成一位有實力的人物；他在七一五年起兵，圍困查理於圖爾與盧瓦什一帶，據《弗雷德加爾編年史》記載，查理是靠堡內一條秘密通道在夜裡逃出的。留下戰事記載的編年史家與傳記作者，則有《弗雷德加爾編年史》續篇、《聖伯丁年鑑》的編纂者、《法蘭克諸王傳略》與艾因哈德《查理大帝傳》的作者；七一五至七一八年的戰事，主要靠這幾部書的殘篇與抄本流傳。
peopleEn: Five names matter most. First, Pepin of Herstal, Pepin II, c. 634 to 714, mayor of the palace of Neustria and the last ruler of the Merovingians to hold real power; he died on 16 August 714 at Herstal, leaving an underage son and a widow, and from that corpse the whole chain of cause in this civil war runs. Second, Adaltrude, Pepin's widow, who as regent sided with Neustria and stood in a deadlock against the palace administration of Austrasia. Third, Theuderic IV, c. 710 to 715, crowned as a child; the chroniclers record that he died in 715 at only a few years of age, and later tradition left a report that he was poisoned, though nothing can be confirmed. With his death Charles Martel was able to hold the mayoralty of Austrasia alone and became the only man who governed the kingdom. Fourth, Charles Martel himself, c. 688 to 741, founder of the Carolingian line; he took over Austrasia in 715, acted as a king from 732, and on his death in 741 was succeeded by his son Pepin III, who in 751 deposed the last Merovingian king, Childeric III, and crowned himself. Fifth, Raganaldus, also written Radulfus, the rebel leader of Neustria, presented by the chroniclers as a man of real weight; he rose in 715, blockaded Charles around Tours and Loches, and according to the Chronicle of Fredegar Charles escaped through a secret passage inside the fortress by night. Those who left the record of the fighting are the continuator of the Chronicle of Fredegar, the compilers of the Annals of St-Bertin, the Epitome of Frankish History and the author of Einhard's Vita Karoli; the wars of 715 to 718 survive mainly in fragments and copies of these books.
kits: 卡面這件羅馬弩砲是古羅馬的扭力式弩砲，靠絞緊的繩束儲存彈力，一發一具箭，架在低矮木架或城頭射位上，用來直射牆頭與密集人陣。卡面標的年代約在公元前五十年，正好對應凱撒《高盧戰記》第七卷記載的攻城細節：羅馬軍隊用 scorpiones 射擊牆上守軍與壕溝旁的目標，阿萊西亞的守軍也用同類弩砲打擊進攻城塔的底座。戰役背景則是：到七一五年，這門技術在西部歐洲已失傳七百年，羅馬末期與高盧時期之後，編年史再沒有人提過任何一具羅馬式弩砲，留下的只是拉丁文獻裡的名目——七世紀的《詞源學》把 scorpio 列為弩砲的一種，說它形制小、以弩箭射擊，《兵法概要》也描述過裝在車架上的小型弩砲，並把弩砲列進步兵百人隊的裝備。因此本場內戰的實戰裝備與卡面毫無關係：法蘭克步兵的骨架是鐵環甲，配圓盾、長矛（angon）、雙刃斧（francisca）、弓與短柄投矛，頸側常加金屬護片；騎兵配馬、矛、盾與長刀（spatha），但在墨洛溫晚期仍屬精銳而非主力。攻城方沒有羅馬砲，改用最樸素的辦法：披甲工匠與工兵沿壕溝作業、覆蓋木棚推進、把石頭與柴束投向城頭，或直接放火燒木構城牆；防守方以土壘、壕溝、木柵與高處據點為主，火藥兵器在歐洲尚未出現。薩克森與弗里西的戰士幾乎全是步卒，攻城器械極少，這正是他們能圍困尼美根卻守不住自己城鎮的原因。卡面兵器在此戰的位置只能說是古物：它是羅馬工程傳統最後的標本，說明七一五年的攻城技術已退回到人力與火焰的時代。
kitsEn: The Roman scorpio on the card is a torsion-powered bolt-thrower: the elastic energy is stored in twisted skeins of cord, it shoots a single bolt at a time, and it stands on a low wooden frame or in a parapet emplacement, aimed at the top of a wall or at a massed body of men. The date the card carries, about fifty years before Christ, fits exactly the siege detail Caesar gives in the seventh book of the Commentarii de Bello Gallico: the Roman troops used scorpiones against the defenders on the wall and beside the ditch, and the defenders of Alesia in turn used the same class of engine against the base of the Roman siege-towers. The setting of the battle, then, is this: by 715 the craft had been lost in the western half of Europe for seven hundred years, and after its last reliable appearances in late Roman and Gallic warfare no chronicler ever again mentioned a Roman bolt-thrower; only the name survived in the Latin books. The seventh-century Etymologies lists the scorpio among the ballistae, describing it as the smaller form that shoots bolts; the Epitoma rei militaris describes a small engine carried on a wheeled carriage and lists the bolt-thrower among the equipment of the infantry cohort. In practice the kit therefore has no bearing on the field of 715. The backbone of the Frankish infantry was mail, with round shields, the long angon, the double-edged francisca axe, the bow and short javelins, and a metal plate often protecting the neck; the cavalry carried spear, shield and spatha, but in the late Merovingian period it was an elite rather than a mass. The besiegers had no Roman artillery and fell back on the plainest of measures: armoured engineers working along ditches and covered galleries, stones and faggots thrown at the parapet, or fire set directly against wooden curtain walls; the defenders relied on earthworks, ditches, palisades and elevated strongpoints, and gunpowder weapons had not yet appeared anywhere in Europe. The Saxon and Frisian warriors were almost entirely foot with very little siege equipment, which is precisely why they could besiege Nijmegen yet could not hold their own towns. The card's weapon can only be called an antique: it is the last specimen of the Roman engineering tradition, and its presence marks how far siegecraft had already retreated to the age of manpower and fire.
tactics: 墨洛溫王朝的內戰很少出現正面會戰，多半是宮廷政變、地方起義與圍城交錯在一起，雙方的作戰重心放在控制交通線與據點，而不是在戰場上求殲滅。拉加納爾德起兵後，紐斯特里亞的貴族兵被召集起來，兵鋒直指奧斯特拉西亞方向；查理·馬泰爾退守盧瓦什堡與圖爾一帶，被圍在要塞與城市之間，據《弗雷德加爾編年史》記載，他最後靠堡內的秘密通道趁夜脫身，帶走貼身隨從，把堡壘與攻城器械留給圍城者。這個棄堡夜走是全場最關鍵的動作：拉加納爾德沒有能就地殲滅查理，便失去速戰速決的機會。與此同時外部戰線爆發：七一六年薩克森人叛亂，七一七年弗里西人與薩克森人圍困尼美根堡，設伏擊敗法蘭克軍，《聖伯丁年鑑》記下法蘭克方面的重大損失；查理隨即反手包圍巴塔維亞，那座城最後在大火中毀滅，雙方的攻勢在萊茵河兩岸互相抵銷。決戰則在七一七年於亞眠附近進行：拉加納爾德集結的紐斯特里亞聯軍被法蘭克軍擊敗，他本人陣亡，一說被擒後處決，叛軍隨後被逐一清剿。作戰方式上，法蘭克人善用營陣，把騎兵與步兵編在車列與帳幕之間推進，遠程用弓，接近後換長矛與斧；攻城則以圍而不攻、斷糧、挖掘與火燒為主，全程不見任何弩砲的記載。
tacticsEn: Merovingian civil wars rarely produced a set-piece battle; they were a mixture of palace coups, provincial revolts and sieges, and both sides aimed at controlling lines of communication and strongpoints rather than at annihilating the enemy in the field. When Raganaldus rose, the Neustrian lords were mustered and the columns drove straight towards Austrasia; Charles Martel fell back on the castle of Loches and the country round Tours, pinned between fortress and town, and according to the Chronicle of Fredegar he finally slipped out by night through a secret passage inside the fortress with his closest followers, leaving the walls and the siege gear to the besiegers. That night escape was the decisive action of the whole affair: unable to annihilate Charles on the spot, Raganaldus lost the chance of a quick decision. At the same time the outer front opened: the Saxons revolted in 716, and in 717 the Frisians and the Saxons besieged the castle of Nijmegen and ambushed a Frankish army, of which the Annals of St-Bertin record heavy losses; Charles then turned and ringed Batavia, and the town was finally destroyed in a great fire, so that the two attacks cancelled each other on opposite banks of the Rhine. The decisive engagement came in 717 near Amiens, where the Neustrian coalition gathered by Raganaldus was beaten by the Frankish army; he was killed in the fighting, in one account captured and afterwards executed, and the rebels were then mopped up one by one. In method the Franks were good at the camp, advancing cavalry and infantry interleaved with the wagon line and the tents, using the bow at range and the long spear and the axe at contact; sieges were run by blockade, starvation, sapping and fire, and throughout there is not one mention of a bolt-throwing engine.
data: 可核的數字不多，編年史基本不列兵力，因此能排出的只有年表與距離。七一四年八月十六日，丕平二世卒於赫斯塔爾；七一五年，提奧德里克四世死，查理·馬泰爾成為奧斯特拉西亞宮相，是年紐斯特里亞的拉加納爾德起兵；七一六年薩克森人叛亂；七一七年，法蘭克人在亞眠附近的野戰中擊敗紐斯特里亞聯軍，拉加納爾德陣亡；同年，弗里西人圍困尼美根，尼美根之敗後查理包圍巴塔維亞並將其焚毀；七一八年，弗里西王波波在萊茵河畔被自己人殺死，弗里西人隨後接受法蘭克宗主權。距離上，亞眠在今法國北部，離巴黎約一百三十公里；盧瓦什在圖爾東南數公里，兩地都是內戰中被圍之地；尼美根在萊茵河下游右岸，與巴塔維亞隔河相望，兩城構成弗里西人的勢力核心；巴塔維亞即今阿姆斯特丹一帶，埃雷斯堡則在今德國薩爾蘭，是七一七年被法蘭克軍攻下的薩克森堡壘。兵力方面，《聖伯丁年鑑》對尼美根伏擊中法蘭克的損失只用眾多、大批這類字眼，沒有可核的數目；後世史家多只作量級推測，並無一致數字。時間上，這場內戰連同與薩克森、弗里西的並行戰事，歷時約三年（715至717），若算到弗里西人屈服則為四年。彈藥消耗則全無記載，因為七一五年的攻城根本沒有投射物可計。
dataEn: The verifiable figures are few, for the chroniclers rarely give numbers of men, so what can be set down is a chronology and some distances. On 16 August 714 Pepin of Herstal died at Herstal. In 715 Theuderic IV died, Charles Martel became mayor of the palace of Austrasia, and Raganaldus rose in Neustria. In 716 the Saxons revolted. In 717 the Franks won a field battle near Amiens, where Raganaldus was killed; in the same year the Frisians besieged Nijmegen, and after the reverse there Charles besieged Batavia and burned it. In 718 Poppo, king of the Frisians, was killed on the Rhine by his own people, and the Frisians then accepted Frankish overlordship. As to distance, Amiens lies in the north of modern France some one hundred and thirty kilometres from Paris; Loches stands a few kilometres south-east of Tours, and both were places where somebody was shut up during the civil war; Nijmegen lies on the right bank of the lower Rhine facing Batavia, and the two towns formed the core of the Frisian power; Batavia is the neighbourhood of modern Amsterdam, while Eresburg stands in the Sauerland of modern Germany and was a Saxon stronghold taken by Frankish arms in 717. On numbers of troops the Annals of St-Bertin use only words such as many and a great multitude for the Frankish losses at Nijmegen, with nothing that can be checked; later historians give only orders of magnitude, and no consistent figure exists. In time the civil war, taken together with the parallel war against the Saxons and the Frisians, ran about three years, from 715 to 717, or four if the Frisian submission is included. There is no record of ammunition consumption whatever, for there was nothing of the kind to count in a siege of 715.
cause: 起因分三層。最表層是七一四年八月的王位變故：丕平二世沒有留下明確的繼承安排，幼子提奧德里克四世即位，寡妻阿達爾特魯德攝政，宮相之權一時分屬紐斯特里亞與奧斯特拉西亞兩個衙署。中間一層是宮相制本身的矛盾：法蘭克王國分成三個宮相區，國王多數在幼年或無能，真正掌兵、掌司法、掌莊園賦稅的是宮相；宮相職位的爭奪在和平年代就已存在，只是通常以陰謀和宮廷暗鬥收場，丕平二世一死，衝突就升級成公開的內戰。更深一層是紐斯特里亞貴族對奧斯特拉西亞方面的排斥：查理·馬泰爾的權力根基在萊茵河，出身與紐斯特里亞的世家大族並不完全一致，編年史把紐斯特里亞人的抗拒寫成他們不肯服從外來的宮相。最後還要加上外部的牽制：薩克森人與弗里西人此時正處在反抗的餘波裡，紐斯特里亞的叛首只要向東、北兩翼一伸手，就能讓王國同時在內外兩線作戰，把一次宮廷政變放大成牽動全境的戰爭。
causeEn: There were three layers of reason. The outermost was the dynastic accident of August 714: Pepin of Herstal left no clear settlement of the succession, his little son Theuderic IV took the throne, the widow Adaltrude held the regency, and for a while the power of the mayor was split between the two administrations of Neustria and Austrasia. A layer deeper was the contradiction built into the mayoralty itself: the Frankish kingdom was cut into three mayoralities, the kings were mostly children or weak, and the one who actually held the army, the courts and the rents of the royal estates was the mayor of the palace. Rivalries over that office had existed in peacetime, but they were usually settled by intrigue and palace manoeuvring; the death of Pepin II turned them into open civil war. Deeper still was the Neustrian aristocracy's repudiation of the Austrasian side: the base of Charles Martel's power lay on the Rhine, and his descent did not match that of the great Neustrian houses in every particular, so the chroniclers wrote the Neustrians' resistance as a refusal to obey a mayor who was a stranger to them. Last of all came the external pressure: the Saxons and the Frisians were still living in the aftermath of revolt, and the Neustrian rebel had only to reach out east and north for the kingdom to be fighting on two fronts at once, turning a palace coup into a war that pulled in the whole realm.
impact: 內戰結束後，法蘭克王國的重心整個移到奧斯特拉西亞，這是結構性的變化。此後二十六年裡，查理·馬泰爾以宮相之名統合三區，直到七四一年他死時，墨洛溫王朝的國王仍由同一家族世襲，實權卻牢牢握在卡洛林家的男性手中；七五一年，其子丕平三世廢黜最後的墨洛溫王奇爾德里克三世加冕稱王，王朝更替由此鋪路。對外，萊茵河下游的弗里西人與薩克森人被逐一平定：巴塔維亞與埃雷斯堡兩處燒毀之後，薩克森人此後二十年的反抗屢起屢敗；七三二年，查理·馬泰爾在圖爾擊敗倭馬亞王朝阿卜杜勒·拉赫曼的軍隊——正是那座在七一五年困住他的城市，二十七年後成了他最著名的戰場。對軍隊與技術，這場戰爭留下的教訓是攻城技術的停滯：羅馬時代累積的攻城工程知識已經斷傳，法蘭克人靠挖掘、火攻與飢餓取勝，直到八、九世紀才重新出現較系統的攻城器械；與此同時，弩砲這一類兵器在拉丁文獻裡只剩下名目與描述，直到文藝復興時代才被重新畫出來。對編年史而言，內戰也留下了一大段含糊：七一五至七一八年間的戰事細節，幾乎全靠弗雷德加爾與艾因哈德兩部書的殘篇。
impactEn: Once the civil war was over the centre of gravity of the Frankish kingdom shifted wholesale to Austrasia, and that was a structural change. For the twenty-six years after it the kingdom was governed by Charles Martel in the name of the mayoralty, and when he died in 741 the Merovingian kings were still drawn from the same house while the real authority remained in the hands of the men of the Carolingian line; in 751 his son Pepin III deposed the last Merovingian king, Childeric III, crowned himself, and the dynastic changeover was thereby prepared. Abroad the Frisians of the lower Rhine and the Saxons were brought one by one to heel: after the burning of Batavia and the taking of Eresburg, Saxon revolt broke out again and again for the next twenty years and was beaten each time; in 732 Charles Martel destroyed the army of the Umayyad cal Abd al-Rahman at Tours, the very city that had held him in 715 becoming, twenty-seven years later, the field of his most famous battle. For the armies and their technique the lesson of this war was the stagnation of siegecraft: the accumulated knowledge of Roman siege engineering had been lost, and the Franks won by sapping, fire and hunger, and it was not until the eighth and ninth centuries that systematic siege engines reappeared; at the same time the bolt-thrower survived in Latin literature as name and description alone, and was not drawn and built again until the Renaissance. For the historiography of the period the civil war left a large lacuna: almost every detail of the fighting between 715 and 718 depends on fragments of Fredegar and Einhard.
result: 結果是紐斯特里亞派系的瓦解與王國的重新統一。拉加納爾德一方在七一七年的亞眠之戰中戰敗，他本人陣亡，餘部被清剿，紐斯特里亞的世家大族在此後數年內相繼失勢；提奧德里克四世已死，王位上只剩下對奧斯特拉西亞宮相無所作為的墨洛溫君主，七一五年之後再沒有人能與查理·馬泰爾平起平坐。同一階段與薩克森、弗里西的戰事也一併收束：七一七年巴塔維亞被焚，尼美根的圍城解除；七一八年弗里西王波波死於萊茵河畔，弗里西人接受法蘭克宗主權，薩克森的反抗則被壓到下一次大規模起事之前。代價則是慘重的：法蘭克軍在尼美根的敗仗與巴塔維亞的焚毀都出自編年史之手，卻只留下眾多這類模糊的數目；紐斯特里亞反叛者的莊園，據莊園文獻，以沒收、交換與賞賜三種方式被清理；王位繼承的合法性問題則原封不動地傳給下一代——七五七年格爾里福的叛亂，以及卡洛林兩支後裔之間反覆的宮廷鬥爭，都是這場內戰留下的伏筆。兵器方面，最終沒有任何一具羅馬弩砲出現在七一五年的戰場上：這門技術在西方失傳七百年之後，要到文藝復興時期才被重新畫成形制並重新造出來。
resultEn: The result was the dissolution of the Neustrian party and the reunification of the kingdom. Raganaldus's side was beaten at the battle near Amiens in 717; he was killed there, the remnants of his following were mopped up, and the great Neustrian houses lost their position one after another in the years that followed. Theuderic IV was already dead, and nothing was left on the throne but a Merovingian monarch who could not act against the mayor of Austrasia; after 715 no one stood level with Charles Martel. The parallel war against the Saxons and the Frisians was closed at the same time: Batavia was burned in 717 and the siege of Nijmegen was lifted; in 718 Poppo died on the Rhine and the Frisians accepted Frankish overlordship, while the Saxon resistance was pushed back until the next rising. The cost was heavy. The Frankish reverse at Nijmegen and the burning of Batavia both come down to us through the chroniclers, who leave nothing but a vague multitude; the estates of the Neustrian rebels were cleared out, according to the estate documents, by confiscation, exchange and favouritism; and the question of the legitimacy of the succession was handed on to the next generation untouched, the revolt of Grifo in 757 and the endless palace quarrels between the two lines of the Carolingian house both lying downstream of this civil war. On the question of weapons, no Roman scorpio ever appeared on a battlefield of 715: after seven hundred years of disappearance in the West, the machine was not drawn again and built again until the Renaissance.
